text.p: Malaysia's Advance Synergy Bhd (ASB) and subsidiary United Merchant Group Bhd shares are to remain suspended for a further four days, said the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange on Tuesday.
In a statement, the exchange said the extension would be granted from May 14 until May 19 in order to "announce the details of ASB's proposed restructuring exercise which involves UMG".
"The application for extension was approved... on the grounds that ASB is still waiting for approval from Bank Negara Malaysia to commence negotiations," said the exchange.
ASB had said on May 2 it was seeking the approval of the central bank to merge its existing financial services operations with another financial services firm.
